question: Does recoverable partial ball-history reconstruction improve target-pin future prediction beyond full-history training and identical history masking alone?
scope: Point-only,already-released rolling-ball diagnostic from paired_response_v1,original10pins/21points/physics. Not robot-release,faithful UNITAS,RGB MAE,causal graph discovery or control.

data.reuse: paired-response-v1/data:train832windows/64families and validation240windows/16families;original packs copied byte-exact;old test never loaded
data.test_generation: Only after3reused A and6new B/C checkpoints lock;360windows,3speeds times5offsets per family. No test-guided changes.
data.physical_generation: Reuse native initial/shoot physics without edits. Up to3initial XY corrections using query position only. No future-response filtering. Include misses. Robot hold plan same independent contact-disabled FK implementation.

mask.entity: Only ball center's10negative-time frames;all pin histories,current21points and robot past/current remain available.
mask.training: Retain exactly2uniformly chosen distinct past frames per occurrence;mask8of10before feature encoding by replacing with current ball position. Current t=0 always available;explicit10bit availability embed. Independent torch.Generator seed+1001,topk2of10uniform scores. B/C masks identical;sample generator seed+1.
mask.evaluation: Primary:all10past ball frames available for every arm. Secondary:fixed retained indices[0,9] at-1.0/-0.1s. No test-derived masks.
mask.recoverability_gate: Before formal training,on train/validation only,least-squares constant velocity through current plus2retained positions,for all45possible masks:mean hidden8frame ADE<=2mm in each split and>=90percent reduction vs repeat-current. This is empirical on this restricted rolling distribution,not unique physical identifiability in general. Failure stops formal comparison.

arms.A: full history,target future only;reuse previous all_history fixed5000 weights only after exact forward/8update equivalence and provenance audit
arms.C: same partial history,target future plus1.0times hidden ball-history coordinate MSE

architecture: Same LocalCollision(1)point-only shared480/480/256 encoders,two8head object relation layers,first100ms target-pin head. Add zero-initialized bias-free10to256ball-availability embedding and zero-initialized256to30ball-history head to ALL arms. Auxiliary branch reruns SAME relation layers on pre-plan nodes;future branch alone receives first100ms nominal robot plan. Future head never reads reconstructed history. Inference primary uses original future path;no output corrections.

training.loss: Future MSE over target-pin2endpoints XYZ. History MSE over8masked ball-center XYZ at negative times only. Weight1,no search or dynamic rescaling. No pin-history reconstruction or ball-future supervision.
training.selection: fixed5000only;validation every500descriptive;no retuning,early stopping,extensions or extra seeds
training.statistics: Exact parent TRAIN input/state buffers,shared acrossarms. No per-instance full-history statistics or label normalization.
training.preflight: CPU8update equivalence discarded;C128update single-batch overfit discarded;one C100update GPU profile discarded. Record all costs separately. 6GiBcap,one admitted development GPU,sequential.

evaluation.primary: Full-history target mean Euclidean endpoint error at100ms;cells then family macro. Compare C-B and C-A;10000family bootstrap draws,seed20261020,average3fixedseeds withinfamily before resampling24families. Report perseed differences and seed dispersion.
evaluation.secondary: Same metrics with fixed2anchor mask;fast-minus-slow response-change R2overall/heldout-involving;heldout-cell absolute error;low-motion true<=1mm fraction predicting>1mm;C hidden-ball ADE vs repeat-current and simple line fit under same mask. Denominators reported.
evaluation.success: C beats both A/B in all3seeds,>=10percent lower mean primary than both,and paired95percent CI C-minus-A/B upper<0. Heldout-cell C-minus-A/B upper<0 and heldout response R2 lower>0 as transfer checks. Report all gates,not only positive ones.
evaluation.interpretation: C improves only masked inference=>missing-data robustness,not full-input representation improvement. Better reconstruction alone is not future gain. Failure is conditional on this mask,head,weight,budget and rolling task,not all MAE. A known from earlier validation but fresh test not generated until9weight lock.

diagnostics: C shared-gradient norm ratio/cosine on same4fixed training minibatches at steps500/2500/5000,read-only,no RNG changes,no optimizer updates. Also future/history learning curves and actual cost;do not tune from diagnostics.
forbidden: claims of general causality or control
